The layouts are those of the real sources; every value is invented (amounts, dates, titles, project and country names, identifiers). Only the shapes that exercise a reading rule are kept.
`finances_one/` has the World Bank Finances One API snapshots `DS00975_31-Dec-{2020,2021,2022}.json` (IBRD) and `DS00976_31-Dec-{2020,2021,2022}.json` (IDA), with the API's field names (`loan_number` or `credit_number`, `disbursed_amount` or `disbursed_amount_us_`, the project name, `end_of_period`). Each has four loans: one new in 2021, one that keeps disbursing, one with nothing disbursed and one whose 2022 flow is negative.
`iati/<publisher>/` has IATI 2.03 activity files laid out as the IATI Bulk Data Service serves them: `asdb` (a loan and a co-financing leg whose identifier ends in a lender code), `afdb` (transactions tagged with `afdb:finance-type-id`, the prefix declared on the activity), `iadb` (two transactions listed twice), `isdb` (the `isdb` prefix declared on the root), `ebrd`, `bcie`, `gef` (activities that declare their disbursements cumulative, with figures that fall), `bmz` (expenditure transactions, values without a currency) and `ec-intpa` (a negative commitment, other identifiers of types A2 and A3).
`gcf/projects.json` has the GCF API's `projects.json` fields the readers use: `ApprovedRef`, `ProjectName`, `ApprovalDate` and each disbursement's `AmountDisbursed`, `AmountDisbursedUSDeq`, `Currency` and `DateEffective`. FP941 is in euros and has an undated line; FP951 has one too.
`gcf/readiness.json` has the array the GCF open data library embeds in its readiness page, with `RequestID`, `AgreementReference`, `ProjectTitle`, `Status`, `ApprovedDate`, `AmountApprovedInUSD` and `AmountDisbursedInUSD`. One grant has no agreement reference.
